note: Old Testament passages the protagonist can come to connect with a journal entry. Nothing here shows in the journal until a conversation or a scroll reveals it, and once found it stays. 'nt_ref' is the New Testament passage that makes (or illustrates) the connection; the player sees it with the link, the protagonist does not read it. Teachers do not agree on everything, so a link may carry a 'dissent'.

relationships.prophecy: A prophecy the New Testament applies
relationships.typology: A pattern the New Testament draws

isaiah_40_3.note: Ezra read me these words himself. I do not know yet what they are for.

malachi_3_1.note: A messenger sent ahead to prepare the way. Yosef spoke of a preacher crying out that the kingdom is near. I am not sure the two belong together.

malachi_4_5.note: Elijah, promised before the great day. Hannah described the preacher's rough clothing, and I cannot stop thinking about the old stories of Elijah.

kings_1_8.note: A hairy man, girt with a girdle of leather. It is how they described Elijah. It is also how Hannah described the preacher.
kings_1_8.dissent: Ezra says a leather girdle is only what poor men wore in the wilderness, and that I should not read too much into clothing.
